# Independent audit: weighted-centerpoint filtering still fails the escort selector

Source read in full:
`candidate 9a6be4fc7a226f55`.

**PASS, no repair needed.**

The midpoint endpoint interval is exactly [(1-a)/2,1], hence is inside
the middle unit interval; multiplying by the same Q preserves that
identity. The lifted hull therefore has precisely the claimed three
positive fibers. All have mass strictly below (2+a)/2. The base depths
at the endpoints are their own masses, while base zero has depth 1+a.
Thus zero is the unique weighted-centerpoint-qualified base.

The finite-base escort weights are exactly those already established by
the attained entropy dual. The selected first coordinate is strictly
between1/2 and k, hence is an actual interior point of the middle fiber.
The cap x1-z>=y has full small endpoint, strictly empty large endpoint,
and a proper middle cut, so its mass is exactly a+1-y. No boundary
choice or unproved criticality enters this upper certificate.

The printed interval and planar arithmetic checks exactly. In d1 the
normalized cap is991/4012=1/4-3/1003. In d2 it is8099/36838=
2/9-785/331542. Both are strict failures at the only qualifying base.

The separate safe center is also fully verified. Reflection of the
small endpoint about the middle cube center gives interval
[(1-a)/4,(1+3a)/4], contained in the large endpoint's interval
[(1-a)/4,(5-a)/4]. This retained measure together with the entire middle
cube is centrally symmetric, so every closed ambient halfspace through
or containing its center captures at least(1+2a)/2. The normalized
guarantee exceeds1/4 and therefore Gamma_d/2 for every d>=1. This retains
all original mass in the denominator and does not assert a counterexample
to OC.

The actual family was already archived for a different selector. The
new conclusion is precisely the failure of the different entropy escort
after imposing weighted integer centerpoint qualification; it is not
being presented as a new body or an obstruction to all continuous points
at the qualifying base.

Reran `supporting computation verify_filtered_entropy_escort_counterexample_defect_transport.py`:
**44 exact checks PASS**.
